notMapped: Borba: partial, described by roads, ribeiras and the Serra d'Ossa; whole municipalities Borba and Vila Viçosa taken, the line also touches Estremoz, Sousel and Alandroal (Bencatel, Pardais, São Bartolomeu parishes)

Évora: partial, limit by Herdade das Cortiçadas, the Évora-Montemor road, ribeira de São Matias, rio Degebe, rio Xarrama and public paths; whole Évora municipality taken plus Montemor-o-Novo, Nossa Senhora da Vila
Granja-Amareleja: small strip between the Póvoa de São Miguel parish limit and the rio Ardila mouth

Moura: partial, described by rio Guadiana, rio Ardila, ribeira de Toutalga, the Serpa-Vila Nova and Brinches-Moura roads; Santo Agostinho, São João Baptista and Santo Amador come as one CAOP union, Sobral da Adiça whole; Pias and São Salvador are named as limits but are Serpa parishes, left out

Redondo: partial, limit by Serra d'Ossa, ribeira de Vale Figueira, Vale de Vasco, Montoito, Machede parish line and ribeira da Pardiela; whole Redondo municipality taken
Reguengos: partial, limit by albufeira da Vigia, rio Degebe, rio Guadiana and the clay band Vendinha-Montoito; whole Reguengos de Monsaraz municipality taken
